name: Reveal of the curcus
source:
The detective agency Rivera received a request to solve a murder that took place in a circus. The detective Arthur and his assistant Oliver infiltrate the circus Chandra to investigate. Who is the murderer......!?


[edited/translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7584]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
里维拉侦探事务所收到了一起马戏团杀人案的破案委托。侦探亚瑟与助手奥利弗潜入钱德拉马戏团展开调查。凶手究竟是谁……！？
